roster_note: Cabins on blocks, canteen cabin, generator, drying shed. Replaces `trailer_park`; also carries the "expedition settlement" reading canon asks for.
residential_program: rows of identical cabins raised on blocks above the ground
a canteen cabin larger than the rest
a generator and fuel store serving the camp
a drying and boot room cabin
a wash block and latrine at the row end
circulation: duckboards connect every cabin to the canteen and the wash block
damage_constraints: some cabins have been stripped for material to repair others; the canteen survives
derive all damage and occupation only from the immutable clean master
use an authored fracture with a gravity-consistent rubble apron, never a cleared box and never per-block random deletion

required_manual_checks: the camp reads as temporary accommodation that stayed too long
